rules.notes: AUTOMATED TOOLS: Permitted with strict rate-limit of max 10 requests/sec. Reports generated solely by automated scanners without manual validation, clear reproduction steps, and demonstrated security impact are rejected. automated_tools_allowed set to true (explicitly stated in policy). | SAFE HARBOR: Policy page indicates safe harbor is offered; full text collapsed/not fully captured. safe_harbor set to true based on partial WebFetch confirmation — confirm exact wording before relying on it. | FINTECH TESTING RESTRICTIONS: Researchers must self-register for testing accounts. Capital.com cannot provide extra demo credits. Live trading on production accounts is implicitly prohibited (policy emphasizes demo/self-registered accounts). No explicit statement found about a mandatory sandbox environment, but the strong implication is production trading systems must not be exploited for financial gain or data access. | KYC/PII: Capital.com is a regulated fintech (CFD/trading platform). Expect KYC data (passport, address proof) to be in scope of high-impact findings but explicitly off-limits to access beyond demonstrating the vulnerability path. Do NOT exfiltrate or retain any PII/KYC data encountered during testing. | BOUNTY STRUCTURE (from policy page): Low €50-€100, Medium €100-€1,000, High €1,000-€5,000, Critical €5,000-€9,000, Exceptional €9,000-€15,000. Maximum bounty determined by vulnerability type cap regardless of CVSS score; final amount based on demonstrated business impact and asset criticality. | Intigriti bounty table coarse-grained — only min/max range known from dump; refine from program Rewards tab if drafting against medium/low severity. | Per-asset severity_cap mapped from dump Tier 1/2/3 and No Bounty. No Bounty assets capped at info (VDP-only within bounty program — won't pay). | TaC required: false. 2FA required (platform side): false. | submission_form is best-guess Intigriti researcher URL — confirm by reading the program page once before pasting. | bucket_listing_allowed defaulted to true (not addressed in policy). bucket_download_allowed defaulted to false (safe default; fintech context makes data download especially sensitive). cve_age_min_days defaulted to 30 (not explicitly stated). requires_ownership_proof defaulted to true (not explicitly stated but implied by standard Intigriti terms).
